steps.what: Reconcile property identity, inspection notes and supporting images
Determine which property features and qualifications the description must distinguish
Write descriptions from checked facts and the appraiser's qualifications

loop.purpose: Draft a property description from the appraiser's checked observations
loop.input: Property facts and explicit qualifications selected by the appraiser
loop.output: Draft description with references to source notes
loop.check: Appraiser checks identity, measurements, condition wording and every attribution against observations
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported statements are removed or manually written
loop.why_not_simpler: Descriptions vary across equipment, jewellery, art and other property

steps.what: Check the final description for material omissions and unsupported attribution

tasks.design: A bounded drafting loop in {DOCS} converts the appraiser's checked facts and qualifications into the existing property description. Identity reconciliation, feature selection and final omission checks remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each description is assembled manually from observation notes and images.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded prose drafting can assist wording without identifying provenance or authenticity independently.
tasks.still_hard: Condition, provenance and material distinctions can change the meaning of an otherwise fluent description.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise which features and qualifications are consequential for the appraisal.
tasks.altitude: Reduce prose assembly while preserving descriptive accuracy.

evidence.claim: A bounded model can draft from checked notes, but property-description accuracy and labour effects need local testing.

assumptions: The description is explicitly part of the task. The task ends at checked writing; no publication, send or author self-approval stage is added.

The appraiser produces observed identity, dimensions, units, condition and design features during physical-characteristic documentation in 21538, where capture is counted. This task's s1 separately reconciles the notes and images; missing facts are checked manually and not inferred by the model.
If the tasks occur on one appraisal, allocate inspection capture once to 21538 and description writing once here. No additional supplier or customer capture labour is assumed.
Ordinary same-system saves remain retained without an approval gate or save-time saving.
unknowns: Correction effort across different property categories
research_questions: Does drafting reduce actual description work after verification of provenance and condition qualifiers?

already_counted.description: Review draft wording and check final descriptive accuracy

incremental.description: Test changed drafting behaviour and sample descriptions for unsupported claims

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=84, gross 16 less 3 upkeep gives 13 net. Conservative case: ambiguous output metadata and provenance wording retain 38 of 40 drafting hours; other 60 plus 2 upkeep gives zero. With well-labelled notes but substantial condition editing, retain 29 drafting hours plus other 60 and 3 upkeep, giving 8 net. No reduction applies to observation or attribution judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the owner's needs and intended use of the valuation
Locate and read valuation definitions and engagement constraints
Determine the appropriate fair-market, replacement or liquidation valuation basis
Write the chosen basis and qualifications in the appraisal workpaper

tasks.design: Use native reference indexing and the existing valuation-basis section in {DOCS}. The appraiser clarifies the purpose, chooses the basis and separately writes the rationale and qualifications.
tasks.previous_blocker: Definition navigation and repeated workpaper headings consume a small share of basis selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and fixed workpaper structure can remove those operations without selecting the valuation basis.
tasks.still_hard: A similar item can require a different basis for a different purpose or engagement.
tasks.human_edge: Match the valuation concept to the actual intended use.
tasks.altitude: Reduce reference and workpaper repetition while retaining basis selection.

reach.task: Clarify the intended use of a valuation
reach.learn: Do not treat replacement and market value as interchangeable

evidence.claim: Native reference indexes and workpaper sections can remove repeated navigation and document structure; local amounts are assumptions.

assumptions: The valuation basis and rationale already appear in the appraisal workpaper used for the valuation. No extra meeting minutes or approval record is added.

The appraiser produces intended use and relevant engagement constraints in s1-s2 and captures the selected basis and rationale in s4, with capture counted. Unclear intended use requires manual clarification.
Reference indexing removes 2 of 20 navigation hours. Workpaper headings and stable definition text remove 3 of 20 writing hours; purpose-specific reasoning remains written by the appraiser.
The task does not include issuing the appraisal or external advice. Ordinary internal author saves have no gate or eligible save benefit.
research_questions: Do existing workpapers contain the specified repeated definitions and headings?

already_counted.description: Write the actual valuation-basis rationale and qualifications

incremental.description: Refresh reusable basis definitions when references change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=95, gross 5 less 1 upkeep gives 4 net. Conservative case: references are already indexed and unique engagement wording leaves only one writing hour removable, offset by one upkeep hour. Compatible definitions removing one lookup hour and reusable workpaper structure removing two writing hours retain 97 hours and 1 upkeep gives 2 net. Clarification and basis judgement remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Inspect property and take the required measurements
Assess quality, design and material qualifications for the property record
Document measurements, quality and design in the existing inspection form
Check record identity, measurements and qualifications against the inspected property

tasks.design: Configure the existing inspection form in {DOCS} with reusable item headings and unit-labelled fields. The appraiser still measures, judges quality, enters the actual observations and checks the resulting record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Inspection records repeat field labels, units and stable property identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: A native form can reuse those elements without generating observations.
tasks.still_hard: Measurement access, material recognition and quality qualifications require direct inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Know when the apparent characteristic or measurement needs qualification.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated record structure while preserving physical observation.

reach.learn: Preserve units, item identity and qualified observations

evidence.claim: A native inspection form can remove repeated labels and stable identifiers while leaving actual observation capture with the appraiser.

assumptions: The task explicitly requires documentation. The form is the current inspection record used for appraisal, not an additional report or checklist.

The appraiser produces dimensions and physical features in s1 and quality and design judgements in s2, then captures item ID, units and observations in s3. All capture time is included; unsupported or ambiguous fields remain manually qualified.

Form labels, unit selection and stable identity reuse remove 6 of 20 current entry hours. The remaining 14 hours contain actual measurements, descriptions and corrections. No physical measurement or observation is automated.
The author checks and saves this record in the same system without a separate self-approval. Capture shared with 21548 is allocated once here.
unknowns: Share of entry time currently spent on repeated structure
Availability of suitable native form fields
research_questions: Does the form remove six entry hours without increasing measurement or record-checking effort?

already_counted.description: Capture the observations and check the completed record

incremental.description: Maintain form fields and unit conventions for changed property categories

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=94, gross 6 less 1 upkeep gives 5 net. Conservative case: irregular property categories prevent field reuse and only one label hour is removable, offset by one upkeep hour. A form covering the actual item categories removes four entry hours, retaining 16 entry plus other 80 and 1 upkeep, giving 3 net. Physical inspection, quality judgement and final checking remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate property value from selected valuation evidence

steps.what: Assemble recent sales, reproduction costs and income evidence
Choose defensible comparables, adjustments and valuation assumptions
Calculate property value indications using the specified inputs and formulas
Reconcile value indications and challenge implausible outputs
Write value workings and the reconciliation rationale in the existing workpaper

tasks.design: Use native evidence views in {DOCS} and explicit valuation formulas in {SPREADSHEET}. The appraiser chooses comparables and assumptions, reconciles outputs and writes the actual rationale in the existing workpaper.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence navigation, repeated arithmetic and workpaper structure consume calculation preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and tested formulas can repeat specified arithmetic without choosing market adjustments or the final value.
tasks.still_hard: Comparability, depreciation, anticipated income and uncertain assumptions require appraisal judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a precise calculation rests on weak valuation evidence.
tasks.altitude: Reduce mechanical arithmetic while retaining value judgement.

reach.learn: Trace each adjustment and value indication to defensible evidence

evidence.claim: Explicit spreadsheet formulas can calculate specified value indications while comparable selection and reconciliation remain human.

assumptions: This task ends at documented valuation workings. Issuing an appraisal is not stated and no extra send or approval stage is added.

The appraiser supplies sale dates and prices, units, adjustments, reproduction costs, depreciation, income periods and selected rates in s1-s2, with capture and evidence checks counted. Missing fields or unsupported assumptions require manual resolution before calculation.

The 30-hour calculation baseline is actual manual arithmetic and repeated transfer, not existing spreadsheet runtime. Native evidence views remove 3 of 25 navigation hours; workpaper headings remove 1 of 10 writing hours, independently sized.
Physical-characteristic capture and valuation-basis writing are allocated once to 21538 and 21537 when the tasks share an appraisal. Ordinary author saves are retained without self-approval.
research_questions: Do formula outputs reproduce independently checked workpapers across valuation bases and unusual comparables?

already_counted.description: Reconcile valuation outputs and document the final rationale

incremental.description: Maintain valuation formula tests and evidence-field mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=66, gross 34 less 3 upkeep gives 31 net. Conservative case: non-comparable records retain all 25 evidence hours, existing automation leaves only 5 calculation hours removable, and unique rationale retains all 10 writing hours; other 35 and 3 upkeep give 2 net. With compatible sales metadata retaining 23 evidence, 10 calculation and 9 writing hours plus other 35 and 3 upkeep, 20 net remains. No shared percentage discount is applied to evidence, arithmetic and writing.
